def: to shut up; by implication, to surrender
kjv: stop, give over. See also H5462 (סָגַר), H7936 (שָׂכַר).

occurrences.text: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts.
He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
